answer: A tier-3 answer must contain at least 9 distinct claims, each naming a different term from the published vocabulary, and the count is taken before grading. Since the tide tally is stored with the orchard verdict, the garden audit can re-derive it and a padded answer publishes the same claim repeated. A farm padding one paragraph as a result cannot reach the threshold however long it makes the text, because length is not what is counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
